question: Do past-only lexical-neighbor residuals improve later Classification predictions over the frozen C16 baseline and a within-cycle-by-probability-decile shuffled-residual control at additional origins?

pilot_lineage.pilot_use: reuse saved W4/W6 and H12_L evidence; do not refit pilot origins

baseline: exact verified C16 cache baseline_prediction route (present .75*C2_B + .25*sparse25 raw; missing C4-HGB); never use C16 candidate prediction as the A02 baseline

bank_recipe.source: verified C16 baseline_prediction OOF probabilities joined by official Train row positions and record_id
bank_recipe.rows: complete declared four-cycle OOF blocks only, score cycles 56 through origin inclusive, sorted by official Train row position for deterministic alignment
bank_recipe.residual: official Train artifact_signal - C16 baseline_prediction; only past OOF labels enter the residual bank
bank_recipe.future_policy: bank cycle must be <= origin; query cycle must be > origin; CSV row order is not temporal order

text_space.fit_population: all official Train feature texts with cycle_code <= origin, including empty streams as empty documents
text_space.stable_tie_break: similarity descending then official Train row position ascending

residual_predictor.matched_control: shuffle residual values within cycle_code x min(9,floor(10*OOF probability)); stable source order; numpy default_rng(42) reset once per origin
residual_predictor.missing_stream: candidate probability equals C16 baseline exactly

W1.route: exact C16 baseline fallback for both comparison arms; no learned residual bank

W4.route: reuse saved A02 pilot observed and shuffled predictions

W6.route: reuse saved A02 pilot observed and shuffled predictions

inherited_H12_L.source: saved pilot E67 predictions; re-used development rows, not independent confirmation

evaluation.endpoint_diagnostic: count p exactly 0 or 1, wrong endpoints, and their candidate-minus-baseline log-loss contribution without modifying predictions
evaluation.labels: official Train artifact_signal joined by score_rows only after predictions are produced; NPZ labels are thresholded predictions, not y_true
evaluation.temporal_bias: evaluation cycles were used in prior research; only the origin-specific A02 predictions are new. Do not describe these views as untouched holdout or independent confirmation.

subgroups.comparison: all subgroup harms are measured against the exact C16 baseline on the same rows

conditional_final.only_if: all scientific gates PASS and no RISK_REVIEW_HOLD
conditional_final.OOF_residual_bank: present-stream rows 56-79 from six validated C16 OOF blocks ending at origin 75
conditional_final.base_probabilities: reuse verified full-Train C16 sparse25 route from experiments/runs/optimization_v3_inference/v3_cls_sparse25.npz; no baseline refit
conditional_final.test_use: official Test features/IDs and SampleSubmission may be read only after all gates pass, for this single inference
conditional_final.outputs: one verified 29,421-row CSV and manifest; do not submit to Kaggle without separate Sol review

interpretation_limits: This is predictive-association evidence on reused development cycles, not causal evidence or untouched temporal confirmation.
The E55 W1 fallback is the exact C16 baseline and is not a learned A02 origin fit.
The full-six evaluation has five learned A02 origins including two inherited pilot origins, not six new fits.
A02 remains pilot-only unless the prespecified continuation and risk gates pass.
